description:
FOUND s494g (Opus, 2026-09-25).  s494g derives inherited ignores from the dispositions at boot (so `nohup`'s HUP reads back as 'IGNORE' and stays ignored, as in perl), but SBCL's C runtime has already overwritten INT TERM ALRM CHLD (caught) and PIPE (ignored by SBCL itself) before any Lisp runs, so their inherited state is lost: they start at perl's DEFAULT.  perl, run as `sh -c 'perl prog &'`, ignores INT; PCL dies on it.  DESIGN (not done): the launchers all go through tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm, which runs as perl BEFORE sbcl starts and sees the real dispositions in its own %SIG -- export them in one env var (e.g. PCL_SIG_INHERITED_IGN=INT,PIPE) that %p-signals-boot reads and UNSETENVs (it must not reach %ENV or children).  A standalone executable (pl2cl --executable) has no launcher and keeps today's answer.

=== DONE (s498c) ===
FIXED by mechanism (i), not the launcher env var sketched above: the runtime ENCAPSULATES sb-kernel:signal-cold-init-or-reinit (saved with the core) and records every SIG_IGN before SBCL installs its handlers; sigaction is called through SBCL's own dlopen/dlsym, because the alien linkage table is not rebuilt yet at that point (the linked call FAULTED at boot -- measured).  The env-var design was rejected by construction: Pl/t/signals-01.t, every direct `sbcl --core`, an installed pcl.core and an executable bypass the perl launcher.  Inherited INT TERM ALRM PIPE ignores are kept and read back 'IGNORE'; CHLD is reset as perl resets it (probed).  Also perl_destruct's STDOUT rule (`Unable to flush stdout`, 0 -> 1) and a failed write discarding its buffer, which the PIPE case needs.  Guards Pl/t/signals-01.t rows 17-21 (17-19 fail on 24422497).  Residue: SOURCE MODE (PCL_NO_CORE=1) cannot capture -- not-supported "%SIG".  This was CI run 36192024430's row 11 (the .NET runner ignores SIGPIPE for its children).
CI GREEN on cbb683de (run 36237155154, 2026-09-26): job `gate`, every step success, incl. "Test gate (prove, fresh saved core)" -- the runner that failed signals-01.t rows 9-11 on 24422497 (run 36192024430).
subject: EDGE (found by #2107): an INHERITED SIG_IGN on a signal SBCL resets at start-up (INT TERM ALRM CHLD PIPE) is invisible -- perl keeps it (the background job of a non-interactive shell ignores INT; `trap "" PIPE`)
